title: Cheng Xuanying
shortSummary: Cheng Xuanying offers an entry into early Tang interpretation of the Daodejing and Zhuangzi and its Daoist knowledge networks.
curatorialDescription: The record places commentary among text versions, Daoist institutions and imperial knowledge systems without treating later summaries as direct biography.
researchNote: Life dates, offices and commentary transmission still require item-level verification against catalogues and biographical records.
